purpose: Durable lifetime binding between one DANTE Account and one verified external provider identity; issuer plus subject is the identity authority.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_identity_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(status_changed_at) AND isfinite(last_authenticated_at) AND status_changed_at>=created_at AND last_authenticated_at>=created_at
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_identity_provider_email
check_constraints.expression_contract: (provider_email_address IS NULL AND provider_email_private IS NULL) OR (provider_email_address IS NOT NULL AND provider_email_address=btrim(provider_email_address) AND provider_email_address<>'' AND char_length(provider_email_address)<=320 AND provider_email_private IS NOT NULL)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_identity_provider_issuer
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_identity_revocation
check_constraints.expression_contract: (status_code='active' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason_code IS NULL) OR (status_code='revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(revoked_at) AND revoked_at>=created_at AND revocation_reason_code IN ('user_unlinked','provider_revoked','provider_account_deleted'))
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

state_history.current_binding: Current M5 security state follows the reviewed lifecycle contract.
state_history.chronology: Timestamps encode bounded current security lifecycle rather than a general event log.
state_history.immutability_policy: Identity/ownership fields are immutable unless the M5 contract explicitly permits a bounded lifecycle update.

lifecycle.retention: Retained or purged according to the reviewed M5 durable/ephemeral lifecycle.
lifecycle.redaction: Security identifiers, provider data and verifiers are not exposed outside authorized paths.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE exists only where the M5 contract defines ephemeral consume/cleanup; durable credentials use logical revocation.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL catalog, constraint, ACL and migration proof for the M5 persistence foundation.
